chapter: Funerals, dances and the end of the parades
title: Dance steps and his last funeral, for Picou
summary: White describes the dancing at Millenberg and his last funeral, for Picou, with the Excelsior and Onward bands going to the cemetery.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Yeah, Carolina. . . . Booms.... DING DING DING DING DING DING DING DING Booms.... That's where you could dance at a wall or you could dance at a shardies. But mostly, most of the people who always did dance were shardies or walls. That was the walls. And shardies, they used to take that for shardies too. You see the dance would have them to. But mostly, they all would have, mostly all of them, there was a few you would catch on the floor could dance at walls, could dance at a shardies. Now all the rest of them, you know like fostry and all like that, they got them some. Like Ginnybug, you know what I mean? Take her and throw her from this way, grab her and dance with her and throw her this way and then grab her back and then grab her this way and throw her back and then grab her back and you know. That used to be like that. But, when we used to, sometimes we used to catch them like that and dance even, you see. Catch her like that and dance nice with them. There wasn't nothing man, there wasn't nothing that goes on. Shucks, I used to second line. Used to be buying everything. There wasn't nothing past me. But since, since it done start that, I don't bother with no parade no more. Now last time I made a funeral, that was, with this funeral, what I tell you about, Ricard, not Ricard, this brother was died there. Peek-coo, Peek-coo. I was behind his funeral and apparently had some people too. Don't believe Don't think they didn't. I want to touch this, to touch this one in front. The Excelsis was in the back. Now the Excelsis played all the way to the cement. Then the musicians, they went to Manalov Cemetery. The Turks onward then, they took, they got in a bus, they got in a, they had a car, well all the band got in the car, you know, and got to the cemetery where we opened up, you see, and when they brought them out, then they stayed. Boom, boom, boom, boom. Boom, boom, boom, boom. boom boom boom boom boom boom boom bamboo You stay there till we... You stay there till we close the... Go back around! Well we stay there until we close the... We can stop!
We'll stop it. We can stop it.
